scope: Agent platform course-correction batch after iron-law rebaseline

tasks.title: Agent 平台纠偏重构基线
tasks.description: Freeze legacy execution direction, classify implemented assets, and rebaseline ownership, tool calling, writeback review, and capability supply around the updated iron-law documents.
steps: Audit completed task batches, active OpenSpec changes, and implemented code into keep / rename-rebind / refactor / freeze-supersede categories
Refactor main-agent and sub-agent ownership so Sub-Agent state belongs to the current user's main Agent instead of department-specific mock entities
Rebaseline tool descriptors, capability status, history, observability, and built-in Skill surfaces to the Tool Calling 2.0 and capability-supply model
Promote existing writeback adapters into a staged review flow with user-only accept/reject semantics
Verify corrected behavior with targeted session, settings, workbench, and writeback tests
